correctness.rationale: For q>=3 pairwise distinct cyclic run letters, each directed boundary a_i a_(i+1) occurs at one phase modulo p, fixing start phase of any factor containing a boundary. Closed factors split into disjoint constant words a_i^s (p types), complete first returns with constant frontier B_(i,s)=a_i^s full intermediate runs a_i^s (p types), and mixed-frontier returns of length p+m indexed by phases t in [0,h_k(m)-1] where first m letters cross a boundary. These mixed returns have exactly two occurrences of their length-m prefix, at offsets 0 and p; constant prefixes excluded in count sum_i(r_i-m+1)_+. The sum of h_k(m) for 1<=m<=(k-1)p is (k-2)p^2+p(p+1)/2, and the exclusions sum_i r_i(r_i+1)/2. Thus all length coefficients and C_+(W)=(k-2)p^2+(p^2-sum r_i^2)/2+2p. Independently enumerated literal proper-border closed factors for all 27 3-run vectors in {1,2,3}^3 at k=2 and 3; every factor set and total agreed. Source checker covers 4032 cases but was inspected, not blindly used as infinite proof.
